# Preview base photos: what exists and what is missing

<!-- Generated by `npm run previews:report` from src/config/baseImages.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

**8 of 8** product × stitch × material combinations have a light-cream base photo and fabric mask.
Each base photo is recoloured in the browser into every colour in src/config/palette.ts, so no per-colour
photos are needed. Size is shown by the dimensions and the size diagram, never by enlarging the photo.

| Scarf | Half double crochet | Acrylic–wool–alpaca blend | `scarf-hdc-acrylic_wool_alpaca-base-v1` | scarf_small_hdc_alpaca-blend_cream.png |
